## 학문적 기여란 무엇인가

분야의 학술적 정의에 따르면 *이론*이란 "현상이 어떻게 그리고/또는 왜 발생하는지를 보여주는 개념들과 그 상호관계의 서술"이다 [@corley2011]. 소비자 연구는 **이론 개발**(이러한 서술을 창조하거나 확장함)과 **이론 적용**(기존 이론을 실질적 문제에 배치함)으로 나뉜다. @janiszewski2016 은 지식 생산을 연역적-개념적 조작과 누적적 "지식의 나무"로의 통합으로 구조화한다. 심사위원들이 보상하는 생성적 전략은 **학제 간 가교**, **가정 비판**, **매개 및 조절 변수의 도입**, **대비적 설명**, **타 분야 구성개념의 차용 및 융합**이다.

## 불확실성 하에서의 판단: 휴리스틱과 편향

행동 소비자 연구의 주춧돌은 사람들이 확률을 평가하고 가치를 예측할 때 확률 계산이 아니라 대략 유용하지만 체계적이고 예측 가능한 오류를 낳는 소수의 **휴리스틱**을 사용한다는 발견이다 [@tversky1974]. 마음은 어려운 질문을 쉬운 질문으로 대체하며, 이 대체는 뚜렷한 흔적을 남긴다.

세 가지 휴리스틱이 핵심을 이룬다. **대표성(representativeness)** 하에서 대상 $A$가 범주 $B$에 속할 확률은 $A$가 $B$와 얼마나 닮았는가로 판단된다. 규범적 사후 확률은 베이즈 정리를 따른다.
$$
\Pr(B \mid A) = \frac{\Pr(A \mid B)\,\Pr(B)}{\Pr(A)},
$$ {#eq-bayes}
그러나 대표성은 우도 항 $\Pr(A\mid B)$만을 추적하고 기저율(base rate) $\Pr(B)$를 무시한다. 이로 인해 **기저율 무시**, **표본 크기에 대한 둔감성**, **우연에 대한 오해**(도박사의 오류), **예측 가능성에 대한 둔감성**, **타당성의 착각**, **평균으로의 회귀에 대한 오해**가 발생한다.

**가용성(availability)** 하에서 빈도나 확률은 사례가 마음에 얼마나 쉽게 떠오르는가(인출 용이성)로 판단된다. 친숙성, 현저성, 최신성, 검색 용이성에 의해 왜곡된다. **닻 내림과 조정(anchoring and adjustment)** 하에서 추정치는 초기값에서 시작하여 최종 답을 향해 불충분하게 조정된다. 결합 사건(모든 부품 작동)의 과대평가와 분리 사건(최소 하나 고장)의 과소평가를 설명한다.

## 전망 이론과 행동적 가격 책정

고전적 소비자는 부 제약 $I$ 하에서 효용 함수를 극대화한다.
$$
\max_{\mathbf{z}} \; U(\mathbf{z}) \quad \text{s.t.} \quad \sum_i p_i z_i \le I.
$$ {#eq-neoclassical}
이 모형은 **프레이밍**을 설명하지 못한다 [@tversky1981]. Thaler의 **심리적 회계(mental accounting)** 이론은 이를 세 가지로 수정했다 [@thaler1985]: 최종 상태의 효용을 준거점으로부터의 *변화*에 정의된 **가치 함수** $v(\cdot)$로 대체하고, 가격을 **준거 가격**으로 대체하며, 화폐의 **대체 가능성(fungibility)**을 완화했다.

가치 함수는 세 가지 특성을 갖는다: 준거점에 대한 이득과 손실로 정의됨; 이득에 대해 오목하고 손실에 대해 볼록함; 손실이 이득보다 가파름(**손실 회피**, $x>0$에 대해 $v(x) < -v(-x)$). [@tbl-hedonic-editing]은 쾌락적 편집(hedonic editing) 원리를 요약한 것이다.

| 경우 | 조건 | 부등식 | 선호되는 부호화 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 복수 이득 | $x>0,\,y>0$ | $v(x)+v(y) > v(x+y)$ | 분리 (Segregate) |
| 복수 손실 | $x>0,\,y>0$ | $v(-x)+v(-y) < v(-(x+y))$ | 통합 (Integrate) |
| 혼합 (순이득) | $x>y>0$ | $v(x)+v(-y) < v(x-y)$ | 통합 (상쇄) |
| 혼합 (순손실) | $y>x>0$ | $v(x)+v(-y)-v(x-y)$ 부호 모호 | $v(x) > v(x-y)+v(-y)$일 때 분리 (은빛 안감 효과) |

: 전망이론 가치 함수 하에서 결합 결과의 쾌락적 편집 [@thaler1985]. {#tbl-hedonic-editing}

심리적 회계는 구매 가치를 두 가지 효용으로 분리한다. 실제 가격 $p$, 가치 등가액 $\bar p$, 준거 가격 $p^{*}$에 대해 **획득 효용**은 $v(\bar p, -p)$이고, **거래 효용**은 거래 자체의 득실인 $v(-p:-p^{*})$이다. 총효용은 다음과 같다.
$$
w(z,p,p^{*}) = v(\bar p, -p) + \beta\, v(-p : -p^{*}).
$$ {#eq-mental-accounting}
여기서 $\beta$는 거래 효용의 가중치이다.

## 정서, 감정 및 기분

현대적 관점은 정서를 정보이자 계산 과정으로 다룬다 [@bagozzi1999]. **정서(affect)**는 감정, 기분, 태도를 포괄하는 상위 개념이다. **감정(emotions)**은 "사건이나 자신의 생각에 대한 평가로부터 발생하는 준비 상태의 정신적 상태"이다 [@bagozzi1999, p. 184]. 감정을 생성하는 엔진은 **평가 이론(appraisal theory)**이다. 목표 관련성과 목표 일치성 차원에서 사건을 평가하여 특정 감정이 생성된다 ([@fig-appraisal]).

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-appraisal
%%| fig-cap: "평가 경로: 사건은 목표 관련성과 일치성 차원에서 평가되어 특정 감정을 생성하고 행동 준비성을 유발한다."
flowchart LR
  E[사건 또는 생각] --> A1{목표 관련성이 있는가?}
  A1 -- 아니오 --> N[감정 없음]
  A1 -- 예 --> A2{목표와 일치하는가?}
  A2 -- 예 --> P[긍정적 감정<br/>기쁨, 자부심]
  A2 -- 아니오 --> Ng[부정적 감정<br/>분노, 두려움, 슬픔]
  P --> R[행동 준비성]
  Ng --> R
```

정서는 **감정 정보 이론(affect-as-information)**을 통해 작동한다 [@pham2001]. 사람들은 대상에 대해 "내가 이것에 대해 어떻게 느끼는가?"를 자문하여 평가의 데이터로 활용한다.

## 동기, 목표 및 자기조절

**동기화된 추론(motivated reasoning)**은 동기가 인지를 우회하는 것이 아니라 인지를 *통해* 작동함을 보여준다 [@kunda1990]. **정확성 목표**는 더 많은 인지적 노력을 투입하게 하는 반면, **방향성 목표**는 원하는 결론을 도출하기 위해 기억과 신념을 편향되게 동원한다.

목표 추구는 위계적으로 조직된다 ([@fig-goal-hierarchy]).

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-goal-hierarchy
%%| fig-cap: "목표 위계. 상위 목표는 '이유'를 제공하고, 하위 목표는 '방법'을 제공하며, 의도가 핵심 목표를 행동으로 연결한다 [@bagozzi1999a]."
flowchart TD
  S[상위 목표<br/>'건강해지기'] --> F[핵심 목표<br/>'체중 감량']
  F --> Sub1[하위 목표<br/>'운동하기']
  F --> Sub2[하위 목표<br/>'식사량 줄이기']
  F -. 의도 .-> Act[수단적 실행 행동]
```

소비자는 완료된 행동을 **목표 진척도**("진전을 이루었으니 쉬어도 됨") 또는 **목표 몰입**("이것이 나의 정체성이니 계속함")으로 해석할 수 있다 [@fishbach2005]. 진척도로 해석되면 탐닉적 선택을 허용하는 면죄부 효과가 발생한다.

## 설득과 태도 변화

**설득 지식 모형(PKM)**은 소비자를 설득의 수동적 수용자가 아니라 **설득에 대한 직관적 이론가**로 파악한다 [@friestad1994]. 설득 에피소드는 대상(target)과 주체(agent) 간의 상호작용이다 ([@fig-pkm]).

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-pkm
%%| fig-cap: "설득 지식 모형: 주체의 설득 시도와 대상의 설득 지식, 주제 지식, 주체 지식 간의 상호작용 [@friestad1994]."
flowchart LR
  subgraph 주체
    AK[주체 지식] --> Attempt[설득 시도]
  end
  subgraph 대상
    PK[설득 지식]
    TK[주제 지식]
    AGK[주체 지식]
  end
  Attempt --> Cope[대처 / 반응]
  PK --> Cope
  TK --> Cope
  AGK --> Cope
  Cope --> Out[태도 및 행동]
```

## 사회적 영향력

**사회적 충격 이론(Social Impact Theory)**에 따르면 타인이 개인에게 미치는 영향력은 세 가지 요인, 즉 **수**(사회적 규모), **즉각성**(근접성), **강도**(중요성)에 따라 비선형적으로 증가한다 [@argo2005; @latan?1981].

## 대인 지각과 소비자의 직관적 신념

소비자는 직관적 심리학자이다. **제품**에 대해서는 **부정성 편향(negativity bias)**이 지배하여 부정적 정보가 더 큰 영향을 미치지만, **서비스**에 대해서는 **긍정성 편향(positivity bias)**이 나타나 긍정적 경험이 브랜드 전체에 대한 우호적 추론을 더 강하게 유도한다 [@folkes2003; @fornell2005]. 친환경 소비는 **여성성** 고정관념을 수반하여 남성의 구매를 주저하게 만들며 [@brough2016], 음식에서는 **"건강한 것은 비싸다"** [@haws2017] 및 **"건강에 나쁜 것이 맛있다"** [@raghunathan2006a]는 직관이 작동한다.

## 문화와 소비자 행동

문화 심리학의 핵심 조절 변수는 **자기해석(self-construal)**이다 [@markus1991]. 상호의존적(동양) 문화는 관계를 통해 자아를 정의하고 **종합적(holistic)** 사고를 하는 반면, 독립적(서양) 문화는 고유성을 통해 자아를 정의하고 **분석적(analytic)** 사고를 한다 [@nisbett2001].

## 친사회적 행동과 도덕성

도덕적 행동은 **도덕적 균형(moral balancing)** 메커니즘을 따른다 [@sachdeva2009]. 도덕적 자아가 확인되면 이후 비도덕적 행동을 허용하는 **도덕적 면죄부(moral licensing)**가 나타나고, 위협받으면 이를 보상하려는 **도덕적 정화(moral cleansing)**가 나타난다.

## 디지털 구전과 바이럴성

콘텐츠가 확산되는 주된 동력은 **각성(arousal)**이다 [@berger2012a]. 긍정적이든 부정적이든 생리적 각성을 유발하는 고각성 감정(경외감, 흥분, 분노, 불안)은 공유를 촉진한다.

## 경험적 소비와 시간

견고한 실증적 규칙성: **동일한 비용일 때 경험은 물질적 재화보다 사람들을 더 행복하게 만드는 경향이 있다(경험적 우위)** [@vanboven2003; @gilovich2015]. 메타 분석에 따르면 이는 주관적 행복 자체보다는 *관계성(relatedness)*에서 비롯되며 사회적 맥락이 제거되면 그 우위가 축소된다 [@weingarten2020]. [@fig-experiential-advantage]는 이 관계를 시뮬레이션으로 보여준다.

```{r experiential-advantage}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-experiential-advantage
#| fig-cap: "동일 비용의 경험적 구매 대 물질적 구매로부터의 시뮬레이션된 행복도. 경험적 우위는 수직적 격차로 나타나며, 사회적 맥락(관계성)이 제거되면 격차가 좁아져 메타 분석이 강조한 조절 효과를 보여준다 [@weingarten2020]."
set.seed(38)

n <- 400
# 경험재의 경우 잠재적 관계성 효익이 평균적으로 더 큼
relatedness_exp <- rnorm(n, mean = 1.0, sd = 0.6)
relatedness_mat <- rnorm(n, mean = 0.2, sd = 0.6)

# 행복도 = 기준 효용 + 가중치 * 관계성 + 노이즈
w <- 1.2
happiness_exp <- 5 + w * relatedness_exp + rnorm(n, 0, 1)
happiness_mat <- 5 + w * relatedness_mat + rnorm(n, 0, 1)

# 반사실: 사회적 경로를 제거하여 구매를 고립시킴 (관계성을 0으로 설정)
happiness_exp_iso <- 5 + rnorm(n, 0, 1)
happiness_mat_iso <- 5 + rnorm(n, 0, 1)

means <- c(
  `경험재 (사회적)` = mean(happiness_exp),
  `물질재 (사회적)` = mean(happiness_mat),
  `경험재 (고립됨)` = mean(happiness_exp_iso),
  `물질재 (고립됨)` = mean(happiness_mat_iso)
)

bp <- barplot(means, ylim = c(0, 7), las = 1, col = c("grey30", "grey70"),
              ylab = "평균 보고된 행복도",
              main = "경험적 우위와 사회적 조절 효과")
text(bp, means + 0.25, labels = round(means, 2))
```

## 핵심 요약

- 대부분의 행동적 소비자 현상은 소수의 기본요소로 귀결된다: 어려운 질문을 쉬운 질문으로 대체하는 **휴리스틱 대체** [@tversky1974], **준거 의존성**과 손실 회피 [@thaler1985], **정보로서의 정서** [@pham2001], **동기화된 목표 지향적 인지** [@kunda1990; @bagozzi1999a].
- 소비자는 **직관적 이론가**이다. 설득 [@friestad1994], 서비스 대 제품 [@folkes2003], 음식 [@raghunathan2006a]에 대한 직관적 이론들이 자극 자체와 함께 반응을 이끈다.
- **자기해석**은 분야의 핵심 조절 변수이다: 기저의 과정 모형을 뒤흔들지 않으면서 문화 전반에 걸쳐 설득, 시간 선호, 판단을 재조정한다 [@markus1991; @nisbett2001].
- **자극 기반 대 기억 기반** 구분([@tbl-paradigms])은 단순한 분류를 넘어 왼쪽 자릿수 효과와 같은 편향이 언제 강화되거나 약화되는지 예측한다 [@sokolova2020].
- 신뢰할 수 있는 인과적 주장은 관찰 데이터와 메커니즘을 조작하는 실험을 결합해야 하며, 이는 혼란 변수가 많은 바이럴성 연구에서 특히 필수적이다 [@berger2012a; @vosoughi2018].

## 추가 권장 문헌

판단 및 의사결정 기초는 @weber2009, 정서 및 감정 어휘는 @bagozzi1999, 설득 지식 프로그램은 @friestad1994, 경험적 소비 문헌은 @gilovich2015 및 @weingarten2020 에 종합되어 있다. 독자들은 이러한 행동적 기본요소를 [@sec-branding]에서 다루는 집계 브랜드 및 수요 모형과 연결할 수 있어야 한다.

# 마케팅 전략 세미나 {#sec-시장ing-전략-seminar}

*Marketing 전략* is the central 구성개념 of the broader 분야 of 전략적
시장ing. Where 전략적 마케팅 names the 분야 of 연구, 마케팅 전략
names its object: the integrated pattern of choices through which a 기업 creates,
communicates, and delivers 가치 to 고객 and, by doing so, attains its
objectives. This 장 is a graduate seminar in that 구성개념. It is organized
not as a march through tactics but as a tour of the questions a doctoral student
must be able to pose and answer: what *is* a 마케팅 전략, how do scholars
build theory about it, how is 시장ing organized inside the 기업 to execute it,
and how do the 시장 the 기업 serves—고객, 채널, and capital
시장—price the results.

The 장 is built around a full-semester doctoral reading map. Two commitments
run through it. The first is *integration*: a 마케팅 전략 is a coherent
pattern of decisions, not a list of independent 시장ing-mix moves, and most of
the 분야's 실증적 work has paradoxically studied the parts rather than the
pattern [@morgan2018]. The second is *책무성*: 전략 is judged by
고객, 재무적, stock-시장, and societal outcomes, so the seminar
repeatedly forces the soft-sounding 구성개념s of 전략—orientation,
역량, culture, 관계s—into contact with hard outcome data. Each
weekly module below pairs a substantive debate with the *실증적 전략* used
to adjudicate it, because nearly every claim in this 분야 is contested on
identification grounds.

## 학기 구성

A doctoral seminar in 마케팅 전략 is the 분야's bridge between 시장ing
and the 기업: it asks not "how do consumers decide?" but "how does 시장ing
create, capture, and sustain 가치 for the 기업 and its owners?" The arc begins at
the **boundary of the 분야**—what 마케팅 전략 *is* as a scholarly domain,
and what theories of 경쟁우위 govern it (the resource-based view,
resource-advantage theory, 동적 역량). From this footing the seminar
moves through the 분야's two great 실증적 engines of the 1990s–2000s: **시장
orientation** (the cultural/behavioral antecedent of 성과) and **시장ing
역량** (the routines that convert resources into 시장 position). These
early modules establish the dependent variable that animates the whole 분야—*기업
성과*—and the 측정 and endogeneity problems that recur every week.

The middle of the semester turns to **자산 and 책무성**: how 시장ing
builds intangible, off-balance-sheet stocks of 가치—브랜드 자산 and 고객
equity—and how those 자산 are priced. This opens onto the **시장ing–finance
interface**, the most active frontier for two decades. The 시장-based-자산
프레임워크 [@srivastava1998] reframed 시장ing outcomes as drivers of shareholder
가치, launching a large event-연구 and stock-return literature linking
만족도, brands, 혁신, and 광고 to 기업가치 and 위험.
Innovation 전략 and the 조직 of the 시장ing function (the CMO,
시장ing's contested influence) sit alongside it, because the recurring policy
question is whether 시장ing is an investment 시장 reward or a cost boards cut.

The seminar closes with **synthesis and method**: B2B and channel 거버넌스 (the
transaction-cost/relational tradition), meta-analyses and 실증적
generalizations (the 분야's accumulated, replicable findings), and a capstone
returning to the opening question—what do we now know, and what should the next
generation of dissertations attack? Throughout, the pedagogy is method-forward:
each module names the identification challenge—cross-절al correlation vs.
causal 효과, reverse causality from 성과 to 시장ing, omitted
기업-quality variables, event-연구 and factor-model confounds—that stands
between a 구성개념 and a finding.

The reading map uses two tags: **[F] = Foundational** (canon a 전략 scholar
is expected to know cold) and **[R] = Frontier/Recent** (an active 연구 front,
refreshed as the literature moves). Each week pairs at least one foundational
anchor with one frontier paper. DOIs are reproduced as verified in the editorial
source; works without a DOI-verified record are named without a link and flagged.

## Week 1 — The domain of 마케팅 전략 {#sec-전략-week-domain}

**주제.** What 마케팅 전략 is as a 분야; levels of 전략 (corporate,
business, functional); the central dependent variable (기업 성과) and its
개념적 layers.

**세부 주제.** Domain definition and foundational premises; the 시장ing concept
vs. 마케팅 전략; outcome chains from 시장ing actions to 재무적
성과; demonstrating 시장ing's 가치 to the 기업.

**방법론.** Conceptual/프레임워크 papers; reading the 분야 as nested literatures.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Varadarajan (2009), "Strategic 시장ing and 마케팅 전략: domain,
  definition, fundamental issues and foundational premises," *JAMS*.
  [doi:10.1007/s11747-009-0176-7](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11747-009-0176-7) —
  the 분야-defining statement of scope; anchors the whole semester. **[F]**
- Rust, Ambler, Carpenter, Kumar & Srivastava (2004), "Measuring Marketing
  Productivity: Current Knowledge and Future Directions," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.68.4.76.42721](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.68.4.76.42721) —
  lays out the chain from 시장ing actions to 재무적 outcomes. **[F]**
- Hanssens & Pauwels (2016), "Demonstrating the Value of Marketing," *Journal of
  Marketing* [@hanssens2016].
  [doi:10.1509/jm.15.0417](https://doi.org/10.1509/jm.15.0417) — modern framing of
  시장ing 책무성 and 가치 demonstration. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Is "마케팅 전략" a coherent domain or a borrowing from
전략적 management? Where does 시장ing's distinct contribution lie?

## Week 2 — Theories of 경쟁우위: RBV and R-A theory {#sec-전략-week-rbv}

**주제.** The 이론적 bedrock: why some 기업들 outperform others, and where
시장ing-based resources fit.

**세부 주제.** Resource-based view; VRIN resources; resource-advantage theory of
competition; 시장-based 자산 as a source of advantage.

**방법론.** Theory-building; 개념적 프레임워크s; the logic of sustainability
tests.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Wernerfelt (1984), "A Resource-Based View of the Firm," *Strategic Management
  Journal*.
  [doi:10.1002/smj.4250050207](https://doi.org/10.1002/smj.4250050207) — the
  originating RBV statement; a cross-disciplinary anchor. **[F]**
- Hunt & Morgan (1995), "The Comparative Advantage Theory of Competition,"
  *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224299505900201](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299505900201) —
  시장ing's own evolutionary, disequilibrium theory of competition. **[F]**
- Srivastava, Shervani & Fahey (1998), "Market-Based Assets and Shareholder
  Value: A Framework for Analysis," *Journal of Marketing* [@srivastava1998].
  [doi:10.1177/002224299806200102](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299806200102) —
  reframes 시장ing outputs as shareholder-가치 drivers; the hinge between RBV
  and the 시장ing–finance interface. **[F]**
- Day & Wensley (1988), "Assessing Advantage: A Framework for Diagnosing
  Competitive Superiority," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224298805200201](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224298805200201) —
  sources vs. positions vs. 성과 outcomes of advantage. **[F]**

**논쟁.** Are 시장ing resources truly inimitable, or transient? Equilibrium
(IO) vs. disequilibrium (R-A) views of competition.

## Week 3 — Market orientation {#sec-전략-week-mo}

**주제.** The behavioral/cultural antecedent of 성과: being
시장-driven.

**세부 주제.** Construct definition (MARKOR vs. MKTOR scales); intelligence
generation/dissemination/responsiveness; culture vs. behavior; antecedents and
moderators of the MO–성과 link.

**방법론.** Scale development and validation; survey 연구; meta-analysis.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Kohli & Jaworski (1990), "Market Orientation: The Construct, Research
  Propositions, and Managerial Implications," *Journal of Marketing*
  [@kohli1990].
  [doi:10.1177/002224299005400201](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299005400201) —
  the behavioral 개념적ization. **[F]**
- Narver & Slater (1990), "The Effect of a Market Orientation on Business
  Profitability," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224299005400403](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299005400403) —
  the cultural 개념적ization plus first profitability test. **[F]**
- Kirca, Jayachandran & Bearden (2005), "Market Orientation: A Meta-Analytic
  Review and Assessment of Its Antecedents and Impact on Performance," *Journal
  of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.69.2.24.60761](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.69.2.24.60761) —
  the meta-analytic verdict; sets up the "how big and when" question. **[F]**

**논쟁.** Culture vs. behavior 측정; does MO cause 성과 or do
profitable 기업들 afford MO (endogeneity)? Is MO necessary but not sufficient?

The seminar develops this module's substantive core in
@sec-전략-시장-orientation below, where Kohli & Jaworski's decomposition of
orientation into three observable behaviors is treated as a worked example of
making an abstract 구성개념 measurable.

## Week 4 — Marketing 역량 {#sec-전략-week-역량}

**주제.** The 조직al routines that translate resources and orientation
into 시장 outcomes.

**세부 주제.** Architecture of 마케팅 역량 (specialized vs.
architectural/cross-functional); benchmarking; 역량 vs. R&D/operations;
the 역량 "gap."

**방법론.** Survey-based 역량 측정; meta-analysis; structural
models.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Day (1994), "The Capabilities of Market-Driven Organizations," *Journal of
  Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224299405800404](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299405800404) —
  inside-out/outside-in/spanning 역량 typology. **[F]**
- Vorhies & Morgan (2005), "Benchmarking Marketing Capabilities for Sustainable
  Competitive Advantage," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.69.1.80.55505](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.69.1.80.55505) —
  measures the distinct 마케팅 역량 and links them to 성과.
  **[F]**
- Krasnikov & Jayachandran (2008), "The Relative Impact of Marketing,
  Research-and-Development, and Operations Capabilities on Firm Performance,"
  *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.72.4.001](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.72.4.001) —
  meta-analytic horse-race showing 마케팅 역량' relative weight. **[F]**
- Morgan, Vorhies & Mason (2009), "Market Orientation, Marketing Capabilities,
  and Firm Performance," *Strategic Management Journal*.
  [doi:10.1002/smj.764](https://doi.org/10.1002/smj.764) — integrates MO and
  역량 as complementary. **[R]**
- Day (2011), "Closing the Marketing Capabilities Gap," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.75.4.183](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.75.4.183) —
  adaptive/dynamic-역량 frontier. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Are 역량 measurable or tautological? Static vs.
dynamic/adaptive 역량; complementarity vs. substitution among functional
역량.

## Week 5 — Dynamic and competitive 전략 {#sec-전략-week-dynamic}

**주제.** Strategy under change: reconfiguring resources; 가치 creation vs.
가치 appropriation.

**세부 주제.** Dynamic 역량; sensing/seizing/transforming; 전략적
emphasis (가치 creation vs. appropriation); product-시장 전략 and cash
flow.

**방법론.** Conceptual + secondary 재무적 data; 전략적-emphasis indices;
cash-flow models.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Teece, Pisano & Shuen (1997), "Dynamic Capabilities and Strategic Management,"
  *Strategic Management Journal*.
  [doi:10.1002/(sici)1097-0266(199708)18:7<509::aid-smj882>3.0.co;2-z](https://doi.org/10.1002/(sici)1097-0266(199708)18:7<509::aid-smj882>3.0.co;2-z)
  — the dynamic-역량 anchor; cross-disciplinary. **[F]**
- Mizik & Jacobson (2003), "Trading Off Between Value Creation and Value
  Appropriation: The Financial Implications of Shifts in Strategic Emphasis,"
  *Journal of Marketing* [@mizik2003].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.67.1.63.18595](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.67.1.63.18595) —
  the creation/appropriation tradeoff with 재무적-시장 evidence. **[F]**
- Vorhies, Morgan & Autry (2009), "Product-Market Strategy and the Marketing
  Capabilities of the Firm: Impact on Market Effectiveness and Cash Flow
  Performance," *Strategic Management Journal*.
  [doi:10.1002/smj.798](https://doi.org/10.1002/smj.798) — fit between 전략
  type and 역량 mix. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Can 동적 역량 be observed or only inferred from outcomes?
Is 가치 appropriation a zero-sum tradeoff with creation?

## Week 6 — Brand equity as a 시장-based 자산 {#sec-전략-week-brand-equity}

**주제.** Brands as durable, off-balance-sheet 자산 that drive cash flows and
주주가치.

**세부 주제.** Customer-based 브랜드 자산 (CBBE); brand knowledge and
associations; brand 가치 and stock 수익률/위험; 재무적 vs. 고객-mindset
지표.

**방법론.** Conceptual 프레임워크s; calendar-time portfolio 수익률; Fama-French
factor models; linking survey brand 지표 to 재무적s.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Keller (1993), "Conceptualizing, Measuring, and Managing Customer-Based Brand
  Equity," *Journal of Marketing* [@keller1993].
  [doi:10.1177/002224299305700101](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224299305700101) —
  the CBBE 프레임워크. **[F]**
- Madden, Fehle & Fournier (2006), "Brands Matter: An Empirical Demonstration of
  the Creation of Shareholder Value Through Branding," *JAMS* [@madden2006].
  [doi:10.1177/0092070305283356](https://doi.org/10.1177/0092070305283356) —
  strong-brand portfolios earn higher 수익률 at lower 위험. **[F]**
- Mizik & Jacobson (2008), "The Financial Value Impact of Perceptual Brand
  Attributes," *Journal of Marketing Research* [@mizik2008].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkr.45.1.15](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkr.45.1.15) — which
  brand-perception dimensions move 기업가치. **[R]**
- Keller (2016), "Reflections on Customer-Based Brand Equity: Perspectives,
  Progress, and Priorities," *AMS Review*.
  [doi:10.1007/s13162-016-0078-z](https://doi.org/10.1007/s13162-016-0078-z) —
  agenda update. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Customer-mindset vs. 재무적 지표—which is the "real" brand
equity? Do brand 효과 survive controls for 기업 quality?

The valuation machinery here—event 연구, response models, 위험 decomposition,
and Tobin's $q$ as the workhorse 기업-가치 outcome—is developed in full in
@sec-전략-branding and in @sec-branding.

## Week 7 — Customer equity and 고객 자산 {#sec-전략-week-고객-equity}

**주제.** The 고객 base as the 기업's central 자산; valuing 고객 and
고객 자산.

**세부 주제.** Customer lifetime 가치 (CLV); 고객-equity drivers
(가치/brand/관계 equity); return on 시장ing; 고객 profitability
and loyalty; from 고객 자산 to 시장 capitalization.

**방법론.** CLV/retention models; cohort and migration models; linking aggregate
CLV to 시장 cap.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Rust, Lemon & Zeithaml (2004), "Return on Marketing: Using Customer Equity to
  Focus Marketing Strategy," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.68.1.109.24030](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.68.1.109.24030) —
  고객-equity drivers and ROI 프레임워크. **[F]**
- Gupta, Lehmann & Stuart (2004), "Valuing Customers," *Journal of Marketing
  Research*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkr.41.1.7.25084](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkr.41.1.7.25084) —
  CLV used to 가치 the 기업; links 고객 지표 to 기업가치. **[F]**
- Bolton, Lemon & Verhoef (2004), "The Theoretical Underpinnings of Customer
  Asset Management: A Framework and Propositions for Future Research," *JAMS*.
  [doi:10.1177/0092070304263341](https://doi.org/10.1177/0092070304263341) —
  고객-자산-management theory. **[F]**
- Kumar & Shah (2009), "Expanding the Role of Marketing: From Customer Equity to
  Market Capitalization," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.73.6.119](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.73.6.119) — links
  고객 자산 to stock-시장 가치. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Are acquisition and retention substitutes or complements? Does the
sum of CLV reconcile with 시장 capitalization? Loyalty–profitability myths.

## Week 8 — Innovation and new-product 전략 {#sec-전략-week-혁신}

**주제.** Innovation as a 전략적 driver of 성장, 기업가치, and 위험.

**세부 주제.** Radical vs. incremental 혁신; the incumbent's curse;
혁신's 효과 on 기업가치 and idiosyncratic/systematic 위험; the
시장ing–R&D interface.

**방법론.** Content-analyzed 혁신 databases; event 연구; long-run
abnormal 수익률; 위험 decomposition.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Chandy & Tellis (2000), "The Incumbent's Curse? Incumbency, Size, and Radical
  Product Innovation," *Journal of Marketing* [@chandy2000].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.64.3.1.18033](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.64.3.1.18033) —
  challenges the 가정 that incumbents cannot innovate radically. **[F]**
- Sorescu & Spanjol (2008), "Innovation's Effect on Firm Value and Risk: Insights
  from Consumer Packaged Goods," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.72.2.114](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.72.2.114) —
  distinguishes 가치 and 위험 효과 of radical vs. incremental 혁신.
  **[R]**

**논쟁.** Does radical 혁신 pay (and for whom)? Is the stock-시장
reaction to 혁신 efficient or biased?

## Week 9 — The 시장ing–finance interface and 기업가치 {#sec-전략-week-finance-interface}

**주제.** The 분야's flagship frontier: connecting 시장ing to shareholder
가치, cash flow, and 위험.

**세부 주제.** Marketing's impact on 기업가치 (level, 성장, volatility,
vulnerability of cash flows); 지표 and 방법론 of the interface; meta-analytic
generalizations of 시장ing→가치 elasticities.

**방법론.** Event 연구; stock-return models; abnormal-수익률 and 위험
지표; meta-analysis of elasticities; the identification/endogeneity toolkit.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Srinivasan & Hanssens (2009), "Marketing and Firm Value: Metrics, Methods,
  Findings, and Future Directions," *Journal of Marketing Research*
  [@srinivasan2009].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkr.46.3.293](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkr.46.3.293) — the
  canonical review/roadmap of the interface. **[F]**
- Edeling & Fischer (2016), "Marketing's Impact on Firm Value: Generalizations
  from a Meta-Analysis," *Journal of Marketing Research* [@edeling2016].
  [doi:10.1509/jmr.14.0046](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmr.14.0046) — meta-analytic
  elasticities of 시장ing on 기업가치. **[R]**
- Edeling, Srinivasan & Hanssens (2021), "The Marketing–Finance Interface: A New
  Integrative Review of Metrics, Methods, and Findings and an Agenda for Future
  Research," *IJRM* [@edeling2021].
  [doi:10.1016/j.ijresmar.2020.09.005](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijresmar.2020.09.005)
  — the current state-of-the-art review. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Does 시장ing *create* 기업가치 or merely *signal* it? Market
efficiency vs. mispricing of 시장ing 자산; reverse causality and omitted
기업-quality controls.

## Week 10 — Marketing and stock 수익률: 만족도, brands, 광고 {#sec-전략-week-stock-수익률}

**주제.** The 실증적 core of the interface—whether 고객- and brand-based
지표 predict abnormal 수익률 and reduce 위험.

**세부 주제.** Customer 만족도 and 주주가치/위험; 만족도 and
cash flow; 광고/R&D and systematic 위험; calendar-time portfolios vs.
event 연구.

**방법론.** Calendar-time portfolio analysis; Fama-French / Carhart factor
models; CAPM-beta decomposition; panel regressions with 위험 controls.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Anderson, Fornell & Mazvancheryl (2004), "Customer Satisfaction and Shareholder
  Value," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.68.4.172.42723](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.68.4.172.42723) —
  만족도 (ACSI) linked to 주주가치. **[F]**
- Fornell, Mithas, Morgeson & Krishnan (2006), "Customer Satisfaction and Stock
  Prices: High Returns, Low Risk," *Journal of Marketing* [@fornell2006].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.70.1.003.qxd](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.70.1.003.qxd) —
  만족도 portfolios earn excess 수익률. **[R]**
- Gruca & Rego (2005), "Customer Satisfaction, Cash Flow, and Shareholder Value,"
  *Journal of Marketing* [@gruca2005고객].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.69.3.115.66364](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.69.3.115.66364) —
  만족도 raises cash-flow 성장 and lowers variability. **[F]**
- McAlister, Srinivasan & Kim (2007), "Advertising, Research and Development, and
  Systematic Risk of the Firm," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.71.1.035](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.71.1.035) —
  시장ing/R&D intensity lowers systematic (시장) 위험. **[F]**

**논쟁.** Are the abnormal 수익률 real or an artifact of 위험-model
misspecification (the Fornell debate)? Mispricing vs. efficient incorporation of
고객 지표.

## Week 11 — Marketing 지표, dashboards, and 책무성 {#sec-전략-week-지표}

**주제.** How 기업들 measure 시장ing, and whether 측정 ability itself
drives 성과.

**세부 주제.** Marketing 성과-측정 systems; metric selection and
dashboards; 시장ing 책무성 and the boardroom; assessing 성과
outcomes.

**방법론.** Survey of 측정 practices; metric taxonomies; linking
측정 systems to outcomes.

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- O'Sullivan & Abela (2007), "Marketing Performance Measurement Ability and Firm
  Performance," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.71.2.079](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.71.2.079) —
  측정 ability is itself associated with 성과 and CEO 만족도
  with 시장ing. **[F]**
- Katsikeas, Morgan, Leonidou & Hult (2016), "Assessing Performance Outcomes in
  Marketing," *Journal of Marketing* [@katsikeas2016].
  [doi:10.1509/jm.15.0287](https://doi.org/10.1509/jm.15.0287) — typology and

- Hanssens & Pauwels (2016), "Demonstrating the Value of Marketing," *Journal of
  Marketing* [@hanssens2016].
  [doi:10.1509/jm.15.0417](https://doi.org/10.1509/jm.15.0417) — frames
  책무성 as the demonstration of 시장ing's 가치 (revisited from Week 1

**논쟁.** Does measuring 시장ing improve it, or do better 기업들 simply measure
more (endogeneity again)? Which 지표 matter—재무적, 고객-mindset, or
시장-position?

## Week 12 — Marketing 조직 and the CMO {#sec-전략-week-조직}

**주제.** How 시장ing is organized inside the 기업, and the contested rise and

**세부 주제.** Marketing-조직 dimensions and determinants;

- Workman, Homburg & Gruner (1998), "Marketing Organization: An Integrative

- Homburg, Workman & Jensen (2000), "Fundamental Changes in Marketing
  Organization: The Movement Toward a Customer-Focused Organizational Structure,"
  *JAMS*.
  [doi:10.1177/0092070300284001](https://doi.org/10.1177/0092070300284001) —

- Verhoef & Leeflang (2009), "Understanding the Marketing Department's Influence

- Moorman & Day (2016), "Organizing for Marketing Excellence," *Journal of

  [doi:10.1509/jm.15.0423](https://doi.org/10.1509/jm.15.0423) — modern

**논쟁.** Is 시장ing's influence genuinely declining, or migrating to other
functions? Centralization vs. dispersion of the function; does a powerful CMO
improve 성과?

The Moorman & Day "시장ing excellence" 프레임워크 is developed as a worked
역량 theory in @sec-전략-excellence, and the CMO-성과 question
becomes a worked identification example in @sec-전략-cmo.

## Week 13 — B2B, 채널, and 거버넌스 {#sec-전략-week-채널}

**주제.** Inter-조직al 마케팅 전략: governing exchange in 채널
and B2B 관계s.

**세부 주제.** Transaction-cost economics in 시장ing; 관계 마케팅 and
commitment; safeguarding specific 자산; 관계-시장ing 효과iveness.

**방법론.** TCE/agency theory; dyadic survey data; meta-analysis;

- Heide & John (1988), "The Role of Dependence Balancing in Safeguarding
  Transaction-Specific Assets in Conventional Channels," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224298805200103](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224298805200103) —
  TCE applied to channel 거버넌스. **[F]**
- Anderson & Weitz (1992), "The Use of Pledges to Build and Sustain Commitment in
  Distribution Channels," *Journal of Marketing Research*.
  [doi:10.1177/002224379202900103](https://doi.org/10.1177/002224379202900103) —

  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.70.4.136](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.70.4.136) —

**논쟁.** Markets vs. hierarchies vs. relational 거버넌스; do

The transaction-cost machinery and the 관계-dynamics extension (commitment
velocity) are developed as worked 거버넌스 and estimation examples in
@sec-전략-채널.

## Week 14 — Meta-analysis, 실증적 generalizations, and synthesis {#sec-전략-week-synthesis}

**주제.** What the 분야 knows with replication-grade confidence; the
service-dominant reframing; the agenda for the next generation.

**세부 주제.** Empirical generalizations and meta-analysis as a knowledge mode;
광고 and 시장-share elasticities; service-dominant logic as an
integrating lens; open frontiers.

**방법론.** Meta-analysis and meta-regression; 실증적-generalization

**주요 읽기 자료.**

- Sethuraman, Tellis & Briesch (2011), "How Well Does Advertising Work?
  Generalizations from Meta-Analysis of Brand Advertising Elasticities," *Journal
  of Marketing Research* [@sethuraman2011].
  [doi:10.1509/jmkr.48.3.457](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkr.48.3.457) — canonical
  실증적 generalization on 광고 elasticity. **[F]**
- Edeling & Himme (2018), "When Does Market Share Matter? New Empirical
  Generalizations from a Meta-Analysis of the Market Share–Performance
  Relationship," *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jm.16.0250](https://doi.org/10.1509/jm.16.0250) — revisits a
  foundational generalization with modern meta-analysis. **[R]**
- Vargo & Lusch (2004), "Evolving to a New Dominant Logic for Marketing,"
  *Journal of Marketing*.
  [doi:10.1509/jmkg.68.1.1.24036](https://doi.org/10.1509/jmkg.68.1.1.24036) —
  integrative reframing of 가치 creation; a capstone debate. **[R]**
- Morgan (2012), "Marketing and Business Performance," *JAMS*.
  [doi:10.1007/s11747-011-0279-9](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11747-011-0279-9) —
  integrative review tying the semester's threads (orientation, 역량,
  자산, 성과) together. **[R]**

**논쟁.** Are 실증적 generalizations stable across eras and contexts? Does
service-dominant logic add explanatory power or relabel existing 구성개념s?

## Foundational vs. frontier at a glance {#sec-전략-foundational-frontier}

**Foundational core** (every 전략 student must know): Wernerfelt (1984); Day
& Wensley (1988); Heide & John (1988); Kohli & Jaworski (1990); Narver & Slater
(1990); Anderson & Weitz (1992); Keller (1993); Day (1994); Hunt & Morgan (1995);
Teece, Pisano & Shuen (1997); Srivastava, Shervani & Fahey (1998); Workman,
Homburg & Gruner (1998); Chandy & Tellis (2000); Mizik & Jacobson (2003); Gupta,
Lehmann & Stuart (2004); Rust, Lemon & Zeithaml (2004); Vorhies & Morgan (2005);
Kirca, Jayachandran & Bearden (2005); Krasnikov & Jayachandran (2008); Varadarajan
(2009); Srinivasan & Hanssens (2009).

**Frontier / actively updated** (refresh each edition): Fornell et al. (2006);
Palmatier et al. (2006); McAlister, Srinivasan & Kim (2007); O'Sullivan & Abela
(2007); Sorescu & Spanjol (2008); Mizik & Jacobson (2008); Morgan, Vorhies & Mason
(2009); Vorhies, Morgan & Autry (2009); Kumar & Shah (2009); Verhoef & Leeflang
(2009); Day (2011); Morgan (2012); Edeling & Fischer (2016); Hanssens & Pauwels
(2016); Katsikeas et al. (2016); Moorman & Day (2016); Keller (2016); Edeling &
Himme (2018); Edeling, Srinivasan & Hanssens (2021).

The split is pedagogical, not chronological: a 1990 paper is foundational because
the 분야 still builds on its 구성개념s; a 2009 review is "frontier" because its
agenda and 지표 are still being executed. Each module deliberately pairs at
least one foundational anchor with one frontier paper so students see both the
canon and its live edge.

## How this 장 expands {#sec-전략-expands}

The weekly map is a backbone, not a ceiling. The remaining 절s develop five
of its modules into worked treatments—turning a reading into an *estimator* with
explicit identifying 가정—and the 장 is designed to grow along four
further axes.

1. **An 실증적-방법론 spine as a parallel track.** Each module already names
   its identification challenge (endogeneity, reverse causality, event-연구
   confounds, factor-model misspecification). A future edition should add a short
   방법론 companion per week—instrumental variables, difference-in-differences,
   control-function approaches, Heckman/selection, calendar-time portfolios,
   Bayesian meta-analysis—so the 장 teaches *how the 분야 adjudicates its
   debates*, not only what it concluded. The worked 절s below model this.
2. **A refreshed frontier every two to three years.** The 시장ing–finance
   interface, 고객-자산 valuation, and 혁신 modules turn over fastest.
   Replace or supplement frontier readings as new meta-analyses and review
   articles appear, keeping the foundational anchors fixed.
3. **Emerging modules as the 분야 grows:** digital/platform and data-driven
   전략 (algorithmic targeting, platform competition, privacy as 전략);
   시장ing and ESG/sustainability and 기업가치; 마케팅 전략 and AI
   (generative AI as 역량 and as competitive disruptor); and causal machine
   learning in 전략 (heterogeneous treatment 효과). Each should follow the
   template: foundational anchor + frontier paper + identification debate.
4. **An internationalized syllabus base.** The current canon is US/*JM*-centric;
   comparative notes from European and Asian doctoral programs would broaden how
   programs weight the finance interface vs. 역량 vs. CCT-adjacent
   전략.

The following 절s supply the worked treatments the map points to.

### Market orientation, operationalized {#sec-전략-시장-orientation}

The most influential operationalization of "고객-facing 역량" is
**시장 지향성**, the implementation of the 시장ing concept. @kohli1990
define it as "the 조직wide generation of 시장 intelligence pertaining
to current and future 고객 needs, dissemination of the intelligence across
departments, and responsiveness to it." The definition decomposes a culture into
three observable behaviors—intelligence *generation*, *dissemination*, and
*responsiveness*—and thereby makes an abstract orientation measurable
(@fig-전략-시장-orientation).

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-strategy-market-orientation
%%| fig-cap: "Market orientation as three observable behaviors. Exogenous market factors and current and future customer needs feed intelligence generation; intelligence is disseminated across departments; the firm responds. Coordinated, cross-departmental work sustains the cycle, and profitability is a consequence rather than a component [@kohli1990]."
flowchart LR
  E["Exogenous market factors<br/>+ current & future customer needs"] --> G["Generation<br/>of market intelligence"]
  G --> D["Dissemination<br/>across departments"]
  D --> R["Responsiveness"]
  R --> P["Profitability<br/>(a consequence)"]
  R -.->|feedback| E
```

Three pillars underpin the 구성개념. *Customer focus* construes 시장
intelligence broadly, spanning both the exogenous 시장 factors that shape
고객 needs and 고객' current and future needs themselves. *Coordinated
시장ing* requires one or more departments to work jointly toward a shared
understanding, so orientation is 조직-wide rather than the property of a
시장ing department. *Profitability* is deliberately placed as a *consequence* of
시장 지향성 rather than a component of it—a modeling choice that keeps the
구성개념 개념적ly clean and lets profitability serve as a dependent variable.
A terminological note carries 전략적 weight: "시장 지향성" is preferred
to "시장ing orientation" because it is less politically charged inside the 기업
and keeps the focus on the 시장 rather than on a single function [@kohli1990].

### Marketing excellence and the 마케팅 조직 {#sec-전략-excellence}

@moorman2016 define **시장ing excellence** as "a superior ability to perform
essential 고객-facing activities that improve 고객, 재무적, stock
시장, and societal outcomes." The definition is deliberately outcome-anchored:
excellence is not a posture but a measurable capacity whose payoff is observable
across four outcome classes.

Excellence rests on four elements of the 마케팅 조직 (MARORG) and is
expressed through seven activities. The four elements are *역량*—complex
bundles of 기업-level skills and knowledge that perform 시장ing tasks and adapt
the 기업 to 시장place change; *configuration*—the structures, 지표, and
incentive and control systems that shape 시장ing activity; *인적 자본*—the
people who create, implement, and evaluate 전략; and *culture*—the shared
가치s, beliefs, behaviors, and artifacts that guide thinking throughout the 기업
[@moorman2016]. These four elements are mobilized through seven activities,
conveniently the "7 A's" (@tbl-전략-seven-as).

| Activity | What the 기업 does |
|---|---|
| **Anticipating** | Reads 시장place changes before they arrive |
| **Adapting** | Reshapes the 기업 to fit those changes |
| **Aligning** | Coordinates processes, structures, and people |
| **Activating** | Triggers efficient, 효과ive individual and 조직al behavior |
| **Accountability** | Creates responsibility for 시장ing 성과 |
| **Attracting** | Draws in 재무적, human, and other resources |
| **Asset management** | Develops and deploys 시장ing 자산 |

: The seven activities through which the 마케팅 조직's four elements are mobilized into 시장ing excellence [@moorman2016]. {#tbl-전략-seven-as}

The MARORG 프레임워크 is a *역량* theory of 전략, and it inherits the
resource-based logic of Week 2: a 역량 confers sustained advantage when it
is valuable, rare, costly to imitate, and embedded in an 조직 able to
exploit it. Capabilities of this kind are precisely what event 연구 later price
when they reward acquirers with strong 시장ing 역량 [@germann2015].

### Branding as 전략적 자산 {#sec-전략-branding}

Branding is where 마케팅 전략 is most fully expressed as a 재무적 자산,
and a large literature connects brand-related actions to capital-시장 outcomes.
@swaminathan2022 synthesize this brand–finance interface, building on earlier
reviews of how 시장ing creates 주주가치
[@srivastava1998; @keller2006; @edeling2016; @edeling2021] and assembling well over
a hundred 연구 that link brand actions to stock-시장 outcomes. The 장 on
@sec-branding develops the behavioral and valuation machinery in full; the present
treatment isolates the *전략적* logic—how brand actions are classified and how
they reach 기업가치.

Four 측정 families dominate. *Event 연구* read the 시장's valuation of
a discrete brand action from short-window stock 수익률. *Response models* extend
the logic to continuous, ongoing brand activity. A third family decomposes 위험
into *idiosyncratic* and *systematic* components, since strong brands can lower a
기업's 위험 as well as raise its 수익률. The fourth uses **기업가치**,
operationalized as Tobin's $q$—the ratio of a 기업's 시장 가치 to the
replacement cost of its 자산,
$$
q = \frac{\text{시장 가치 of the 기업}}{\text{replacement cost of 자산}}.
$$ {#eq-전략-tobins-q}
Values of $q$ above one indicate that 시장 price the 기업 above the cost of
rebuilding its tangible 자산, the wedge being attributable to intangibles such
as brand. The measure has drawn methodological criticism [@bendle2018], to which
the literature has offered replies [@peters2017].

@swaminathan2022 classify brand actions on two axes—*cause* and *scope*—that
together organize the 실증적 findings (@tbl-전략-brand-actions). On cause,
actions are *proactive* (기업-initiated) or *reactive* (responses to external
events such as recalls or disputes). On scope, actions are *전략적* (broad,
long-horizon) or *tactical* (short-horizon 시장ing-mix moves).

| | **Strategic** (broad, long-term) | **Tactical** (short-term) |
|---|---|---|
| **Proactive** | Brand introduction and 혁신; brand architecture (house of brands vs. branded house); brand leverage; reputational capital, CSR, sociopolitical activism | Name changes; quality improvement; 광고; social-media and word-of-mouth communication; pricing and 채널; celebrity endorsement |
| **Reactive** | (Strategic responses to crises and structural threats) | Product recalls; trademark disputes; brand crises (e.g., boycotts) |

: Brand actions classified by cause (proactive/reactive) and scope (전략적/tactical), with representative examples from the brand–finance literature [@swaminathan2022]. {#tbl-전략-brand-actions}

Two 이론적 perspectives explain *why* brand actions move 재무적 outcomes.
Under **signaling theory**, brands are credible signals of quality to consumers
and investors alike, with credibility depending on the signaler, the signal's
quality, the receiver, the environment, and the feedback loop [@connelly2010].
Under **resource-based theory**, a brand generates 가치 when it is valuable,
rare, costly to imitate, and exploited by an organized 기업. Between brand action
and 기업가치 lie *mediators*—brand-quality perceptions, attitudes, engagement,
시장place outcomes such as CLV and 시장 share—and *moderators*—광고,
prior brand strength, 마케팅 역량, and competitive intensity.

### Channels, 거버넌스, and 관계 dynamics {#sec-전략-채널}

When the 기업 must decide whether to make, buy, or ally, **transaction cost
analysis** (TCA) supplies the 거버넌스 logic. TCA sits within the New
Institutional Economics and views the 기업 itself as a *거버넌스 structure*
rather than a production function [@rindfleisch1997]. Its appeal in 시장ing is
twofold: it centers on *exchange*, the discipline's native unit, and its
구성개념s are amenable to survey 측정. @tbl-전략-tca sets out its
behavioral 가정 alongside the transactional dimensions they generate.

| Behavioral 가정 | Transactional dimensions |
|---|---|
| Bounded rationality | Environmental uncertainty |
| Opportunism | Asset specificity |
| Risk neutrality | Transaction frequency |

: The behavioral 가정 and transactional dimensions of 거래비용 분석 [@rindfleisch1997]. {#tbl-전략-tca}

The decisive driver is **자산 specificity**: investments specialized to a
particular exchange create quasi-rents that opportunistic partners can expropriate
under bounded rationality, so high specificity, especially when compounded by
environmental uncertainty, pushes 거버넌스 toward hierarchy [@rindfleisch1997].
As an identification matter, 거버넌스 form is *chosen*: 기업들 select into
integration on the basis of specificity and uncertainty the analyst observes only
partially, so naive regressions of 성과 on 거버넌스 form confound the
treatment with its selection. Credible designs either model the selection
explicitly or exploit exogenous shifts in the cost of an 자산's specificity.

Relationships between exchange partners are not static, and treating them as such
discards the information in their *trajectories*. @palmatier2013 introduce
**commitment velocity**—the rate and direction of change in commitment—and argue
that the dynamic elements of relational 구성개념s forecast future behavior better
than their static levels. The estimator is a **latent 성장 curve model** (LGCM).
For dyad $i$ observed at time $t$, a relational 구성개념 $y_{it}$ is decomposed
into an individual-specific intercept (level) and slope (velocity),
$$
y_{it} = \alpha_i + \beta_i\, t + \varepsilon_{it}, \qquad
\begin{pmatrix}\alpha_i \\ \beta_i\end{pmatrix}
= \begin{pmatrix}\mu_\alpha \\ \mu_\beta\end{pmatrix}
+ \begin{pmatrix}\zeta_{\alpha i} \\ \zeta_{\beta i}\end{pmatrix},
$$ {#eq-전략-lgcm}
where $\alpha_i$ is the dyad's baseline commitment, $\beta_i$ its commitment
velocity, and the random 효과 $(\zeta_{\alpha i}, \zeta_{\beta i})$ capture
heterogeneity across dyads. Identification of the slope factor requires at least
three waves of panel data and rests on the usual LGCM 가정: a correctly
specified 성장 form, errors uncorrelated with the latent factors, and—when
velocity predicts 성과—no time-varying confounder driving both commitment
성장 and the outcome [@palmatier2013]. The substantive lesson—that *change* in a
relational 구성개념 carries information beyond its *level*—generalizes to any
longitudinally measured 전략적 구성개념.

### Human capital: the CMO and 기업 성과 {#sec-전략-cmo}

The 시장ing-조직 프레임워크 names 인적 자본 as one of its four
elements; the cleanest test of its 전략적 가치 asks whether the senior
시장ing role pays off in 기업 성과. The natural unit of analysis is the
presence of a **chief 시장ing officer** (CMO) in the top management team
[@nath2008], and the sharpest estimate comes from a 연구 finding that 기업들 with
a CMO exhibit roughly **15% higher Tobin's $q$** than 기업들 without one
[@germann2015].

That headline number is interesting only if it is *causal*, and the design is
built to make it credible. CMO presence is not randomly assigned, so a
cross-절al comparison confounds the CMO 효과 with whatever drives the
appointment. @germann2015 use two complementary strategies. First, **panel data**
with 기업 fixed 효과 absorb time-invariant heterogeneity, so identification
comes from *within-기업* changes in CMO presence:
$$
y_{it} = \gamma\, \text{CMO}_{it} + \mathbf{x}_{it}^{\top}\boldsymbol{\beta}
        + \mu_i + \tau_t + \varepsilon_{it},
$$ {#eq-전략-cmo-fe}
where $y_{it}$ is Tobin's $q$, $\text{CMO}_{it}$ indicates CMO presence, $\mu_i$ is
a 기업 fixed 효과, $\tau_t$ a year 효과, and $\gamma$ the parameter of
interest. Fixed 효과 do not, however, defeat *time-varying* endogeneity—reverse
causality (rising 성과 funds an appointment) or a contemporaneous shock
driving both. The second 전략 therefore adds **instrumental variables**: a
valid instrument shifts the probability of CMO presence (relevance) without
affecting 기업 성과 except through the CMO (the exclusion restriction). The
exclusion restriction is the 가정 that *cannot* be tested from data and on
which the causal claim ultimately rests [@germann2015]—a worked illustration of
the seminar's recurring point that a 전략적 구성개념 becomes a *finding* only
when its estimator and its identifying 가정 are stated in full.

## 핵심 요점

- Marketing 전략 is an *integrated pattern* of decisions evaluated against
  objectives; the 분야's 실증적 work is biased toward single tactics over
  integrated programs [@morgan2018], and the 14-week map above is organized so each
  module pairs a foundational anchor with a live frontier.
- The semester's spine runs from the **domain** and **theories of advantage**
  (RBV, R-A theory) through **시장 지향성** [@kohli1990] and **시장ing
  역량**, into **brand and 고객 자산**, the **시장ing–finance
  interface** [@srinivasan2009; @edeling2016; @edeling2021], **혁신**
  [@chandy2000], **조직/CMO** [@moorman2016], **채널/거버넌스**, and
  a **meta-analytic synthesis** [@sethuraman2011].
- **Marketing excellence** is an outcome-anchored 역량 resting on four
  조직al elements mobilized through seven activities [@moorman2016];
  **시장 지향성** operationalizes the 고객-facing 역량 as
  intelligence generation, dissemination, and responsiveness [@kohli1990].
- Brand actions reach 기업가치 through signaling and resource-based paths and are
  priced by 시장; the cause × scope taxonomy organizes the evidence, and Tobin's
  $q$ (@eq-전략-tobins-q) is the workhorse outcome [@swaminathan2022].
- Governance (거래비용 분석), 관계 *dynamics* (commitment
  velocity, @eq-전략-lgcm), and 인적 자본 (the CMO 효과,
  @eq-전략-cmo-fe) each become testable only once their estimator and
  identifying 가정—selection, exclusion, correct 성장 form—are made
  explicit.
